 Guzman & Company is an independent investment bank and brokerage firm with a history of innovation and trusted execution. Since our founding, we have built a reputation for delivering new ways of thinking and executing ahead of what’s requested, expected, or mandated—creating unique value for our clients. 
 Leveraging decades of market expertise and a proven execution platform, Guzman provides a broad range of financial services. Our senior team and subject-matter experts are consistently accessible, offering dedicated support to client needs. In 1992, Guzman & Company became the first Hispanic-owned member firm of the New York Stock Exchange. We were early leaders in the evolution of stock buybacks and continue to deliver differentiated insights in this space. Today, our trading desk consistently ranks among the top 10 global brokers, underscoring the firm’s long-standing commitment to performance and client success.
